raw_text: Tracking coordinated inauthentic behavior around the Kashmir video. At least 47 accounts across Telegram and X shared this exact video with near-identical captions within a 90-minute window. Several accounts were created in the last 30 days. The video metadata confirms 2016 origin. Classic recycled content disinformation playbook: take real historical footage, strip context, add urgent present-tense framing.
